purpose: Kognai Kreativ video agent: one 8 second video (2 shots, 480p, no audio) made from your text prompt and checked by a quality reviewer before delivery. Use it when an agent needs a short clip for a social post or a teaser. Rendering takes minutes: the answer is a status link and a result link; on Base the payment is collected only on delivery.

aspect.description: the frame: square, portrait or landscape

state.description: done when the result is ready

status_url.description: poll this while the state is not done

result_url.description: the video file, once the state is done

review_score.description: the quality reviewer score out of 10

examples.description: Unpaid call: HTTP 402 with the x402 terms (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and body).
